secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase Web API Key (Firebase Console → Project Settings → General → Web API Key)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Project ID (Firebase Console → Project Settings → General)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Messaging Sender ID (Firebase Console → Project Settings → Cloud Messaging)

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Web App ID (Firebase Console → Project Settings → General → Your apps → Web app)

secrets.name: BACKEND_ORIGIN
secrets.description: MovieBox backend origin URL (Render/FastAPI service for feed & stream proxying). Optional — falls back to the built-in default.
